name: Ateso
region: Teso sub-region, eastern Uganda: Soroti, Kumi, Ngora, Serere, Katakwi, Amuria, Bukedea, Pallisa (and Tororo Iteso)
translator_note: Everyday Soroti Ateso in the voice of a young professional: 'Kobuk ko UG' for Book, 'Koriŋ esimu sodit' for Call ahead, 'aropiyai ka esimu' for mobile money, 'ai ejokuna ijo' (where you are at ease) for 'where you are comfortable'. Standard Ateso orthography with ŋ (ituŋa, koŋolik, eŋiŋai). Earlier STR renderings are kept (Kigeu, Esiteegi, Kiboi, Ebuni, Ajore, Eong, Aiyalaar, Ayauna, Alosi eong nen) except that the four slogan verbs are now imperatives (Kolot. Koriamu. Kopangis. Koya.) instead of the old verbal nouns (Alosit. Airiamun. Aipangis. Ayauna.), which survive as the nav labels. Imperative and passive verb forms, and words for market-app concepts (rank, grey out, sandbox, plug-in, endpoint, wallet, entertainment) are the weakest points and are listed under uncertain.
